scope: 24 diagnostic hypotheses; no model or training recipe selected by parameter matching

matrix_mac_protocol.unit: one multiply-accumulate is one MAC; raw total for the specified input tensor
matrix_mac_protocol.duration_note: 100 spectral frames correspond to a nominal 1 second at 10 ms hop, not an actual centered waveform-STFT call (which gives 101 frames for 16000 samples)
matrix_mac_protocol.transpose_input: input-grid kernel contributions, including computations later removed by Chomp
matrix_mac_protocol.transpose_output: output-grid dense-convolution proxy including hypothetical multiplies at upsampling zeros; not actual operator MACs

constraints.basis: target paper Table 2; ordinary rounding of parameters in millions to two decimals
